issue.title: Fix Maestro CI script: dash rejects set -o pipefail
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Follow-up to #497. First post-merge `workflow_dispatch` harness run failed before Gradle/Maestro ran.

**Run:** https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/actions/runs/34649217854

## Root cause

`reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner` executes `script:` with `/usr/bin/sh` (Ubuntu **dash**). Our script starts with `set -euo pipefail`; dash returns:

```text
/usr/bin/sh: 1: set: Illegal option -o pipefail
```

Emulator boot succeeded; assembleRelease / Maestro never started.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Workflow script is POSIX-safe or explicitly invokes `bash`
- [ ] `workflow_dispatch` suite `harness` gets past script entry (Gradle attempted)
- [ ] Still not a PR merge gate; cron stays off

## Links

- Refs #497 / epic #488

comments.body: Shipped in https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/511. Dispatching harness on main to verify we get past the dash/pipefail abort.

## Update after #511

#511 removed the `pipefail` dash error, but the job still fails: `android-emulator-runner` executes **each line** of `script:` as a separate `/usr/bin/sh -c …`. Multiline heredocs/`case`/`(` still break (`Syntax error: end of file unexpected`).

Reopening to land the real fix: write a bash script in a prior step, then `script: bash .maestro-ci-run.sh` (single line).

Failed verify run: https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/actions/runs/34650996812
Merged https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/512 — real fix for android-emulator-runner line-by-line `sh -c` (script file + single-line invoke). Redispatching harness to verify.
Fixed by #512 (script file). Verifying Maestro harness on main.

## Harness verify after #512

[Run 34651654936](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/actions/runs/34651654936) got past the dash/`sh -c` failure (prebuild ✅, entered `maestro-ci-emulator.sh`), but the job was **cancelled at the 90m job timeout** during **Build APK + run Maestro on emulator**. No APK / `.maestro/test_output` artifacts.

Likely cause: first `assembleRelease` + emulator boot + Maestro serialized inside one step under a tight 90m budget (emulator also competes with Gradle for CPU/RAM).

Next: raise timeout and/or assemble the APK **before** `android-emulator-runner`, then only `adb install` + Maestro inside the emulator script.
Verified shell fix in #512; timeout addressed by #515 (assemble before emulator + 150m). Closing.
